Messages.Author: Orpheus
Messages.Body:
Echo of Harmonies [BL]
Cardtype: Action Modifier

Cost: 1 blood

Discipline: Melpominee/Presence

Only usable during a referendum.
[pre] If you burn the Edge for a vote, this vampire gains two additional
votes.
[mel] Usable by a ready vampire other than the acting minion. This vampire
gains two votes.
[MEL] Usable by ready vampire other than the acting minion. Move the
political action card used to call the referendum from your ash heap to this
vampire at the end of the action. This vampire may burn that card to call
the referendum as a +1 stealth political action [if he or she meets the
requirements of that card].

When you call the referendum again, do you benefit from the additional vote,
or is it burned before that ?

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jon Stahler wrote:
> So a tapped DoC can play Echo of Harmonies?

Yes. It is an action modifier. Action Modifiers are typically
playable by tapped vampires (since they're usually restricted
to being played by acting vampires, and acting vampires tend
to be tapped).

--
